citations.quote: While in brush, Nidalee becomes ghosted and gains bonus movement speed for a short time, increased when facing a nearby enemy champion. These bonuses briefly persist after exiting brush.

citations.quote: Nidalee hurls a javelin in the target direction that deals magic damage to the first enemy hit, increased by 0% – 225% (based on distance traveled).

core_mechanics.summary: The spear damages the first enemy hit, with increased damage at greater travel distance.

citations.quote: Nidalee's next basic attack within some time will gain bonus range and deal magic damage based on the target's missing health. Hunted Bonus: A Hunted target hit will take increased damage.

core_mechanics.summary: An empowered attack threatens wounded targets and deals increased damage against Hunted targets.

citations.quote: Nidalee lays a trap at the target location that becomes stealthed after arming over 1.5 seconds, lasting for up to 120 seconds and granting sight within its radius.

section_disposition.reason: Brush movement and Hunt are central to recognizing pursuit.
The spear is the ranged opening; calculation edge cases are omitted.
Trap stealth, vision, damage and Hunt initiation are practical recognition effects.
Healing and attack speed affect fight commitment.
The missing-health attack has a distinct finishing role.
Leap range and cooldown reduction explain pursuit.
The frontal arc has a distinct positioning response.
Form access, starting rank and Hunt reset explain the kit structure.

summary: An overview and primary ability cards teach Hunt, human abilities and transformation; distinct cougar variants teach finishing damage, pursuit and frontal area damage.
